$comment: Every agent lifecycle event goes to one entry point, tools/gov.py hook, which reads hook_event_name from stdin. VS Code ignores matchers, so the script filters by tool itself. The osx/linux command changes to the repository root first so the relative path works whatever the hook's cwd is; the script itself locates the repository from its own file location.

SessionStart.osx: sh -c 'cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && python3 tools/gov.py hook'
SessionStart.linux: sh -c 'cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && python3 tools/gov.py hook'

UserPromptSubmit.osx: sh -c 'cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && python3 tools/gov.py hook'
UserPromptSubmit.linux: sh -c 'cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && python3 tools/gov.py hook'
